verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and self-contained. It validly applies a minimal-sum Vieta-jumping argument: assuming the positive integer k is nonsquare gives k >= 2; the proof establishes b^2 > k, constructs the positive integer c = kb - a with 0 < c < b, verifies that (c,b) satisfies the same equation, and obtains a strictly smaller positive solution, contradicting minimality. All algebraic and order arguments are justified, and the proof contains no external citations or hard-prohibition violations.
